title: Protocol and Cover
author: Isandro Coldharbour
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
